reused_facts: Frozen v2 interpretation.json had cap/bold sweeps at u0/10/20/22 and terminal insertion at u0. This run uses the adopted current source, adds local fixed metal/tool/socket constraints and a terminal+12mm-wire-stub exit corridor; no redesign.
scope: Disconnected complete input module on bench at unloaded u0. Main cover/axis/cover bolts removed before terminal tools. Two M3 screws removed before terminal cap. Terminal cap removed before ball. Continuous straight local+Z sweeps at one service pose.
preconditions: release output clamp and withdraw tail from its transverse bore
disconnect/park housing and open intermediate retainers, remove module
remove main cover and relevant axis/cover hardware; support unloaded lever at u0
keep the two rear M3 nuts from falling out
provide free wire slack for terminal lifting; remaining flexible wire path is unverified
positive_controls: Real wrong-stage obstacles, not fake passes: leave main cover on for tool/bolt/cap paths; leave terminal cap on for ball exit. Each must produce volume.
unverified: actual purchased tool/handle and hand clearance or torque
whole flexible remainder of core and housing during disconnection
physical PETG fit, loaded handling or screw retention
